title: Kusanagi Nene — Nervous Departure〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still no Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He asked us to gather because he wants our help with something...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That something probably being his character.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have to agree. When we spoke the other day, he seemed very stuck... I really hope there's something we can do to help.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is he gonna be okay...?
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Ah, you're all here!
Apologies for the delay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And for asking you all to gather on such short notice. But I need your help with something.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The thing is, I'm in the middle of coming up with a story where Nakayama is the protagonist...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I'd like for us to brainstorm about it together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A story about Nakayama...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In other words, he plays a minor role in the show, but is the star of his own life.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And you want to make a story with him as the protagonist?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's exactly right!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, coming up with a story about him on my own has been a struggle.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I beg of you! Please lend me a hand!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He only has three lines in the show, but... I want to bring him to life.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If that's all, then I'd be more than happy to help.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me too! Me too!
Let's all think super duper hard about Nakayama!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, sorry... Don't worry, I was listening.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'll also help.
I've basically figured out my character already.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I am in your debt!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Supporting characters can be main characters if you flip your perspective...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Interesting. I never thought about learning to play a character this way.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This method might help a lot in the future when I'm working on other roles... I should pay close attention to what Tsukasa does and absorb everything I can.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna see a version of Nakayama where he's friends with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... Then, what if he's always smiling when he's at the office?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that would change how he greets others quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Morning!”
“That novelist giving you trouble again?”
“No choice, I suppose...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... He sounds a little too energetic...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nakayama would sound and behave very differently if he were born and raised overseas and a native English speaker.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Th-Then, how about this...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What if Nakayama got sick a lot when he was little and developed a love of books because he wasn't allowed to go outside much?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. And his love of books is the reason he decided to become an editor...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We've come up with a lot of ideas for him. Are any of them sticking out...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, we have quite a few now...
But to be perfectly honest, none of them seem to fit the bill.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Out of all of them, the one about him seeing Hino as his rival seems like the best option...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that'd still only be a fragment of who Nakayama the man is.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, why don't we switch to coming up with ideas based on that version of Nakayama?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The show doesn't open for some time, so there's no need to hurry. I think it'll be good to try a few different approaches.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... We came up with a ton of ideas, but I forgot how hard it is to come up with a story.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If only there were someone we could ask who's really good at this kind of stuff...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we try asking Bakuno to hear what he thinks...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When I watched him recite lines the other day...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: For some reason, I thought I could see what his character's life was like up to that point...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
So, this is just my guess...
But he might be able to help you in a big way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In the end, it's always best to ask someone who's good at whatever it is you're worried about...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was able to take a big step that time by doing just that.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
So, I think you should ask him.
But I really can't tell you what he's gonna say...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, Bakuno...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree.
I'd become so focused on Nakayama that I'd completely forgotten about him.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As it turns out, Bakuno likes to people-watch and come up with stories for those passing by...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, uh! Ignore what I just said!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, yes... You're right trust the experts! Thank you for the tip, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll try contacting him right away!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? N-Now...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The early bird gets the worm, no?
That means I need up jump on this opportunity!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Tsukasa always does this...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I hope this helps Tsukasa figure out how to play his character even just a little bit.)
